title: Concrete cover over reinforcement.
officialText:
The minimum thickness of concrete cover over reinforcement in concrete slabs, reinforced beams and prestressed beams shall comply with this section.

COVER THICKNESS FOR REINFORCED CONCRETE FLOOR OR ROOF SLABS (inches) COVER THICKNESS FOR PRESTRESSED CONCRETE FLOOR OR ROOF SLABS (inches)

MINIMUM COVER FOR MAIN REINFORCING BARS OF REINFORCED CONCRETE BEAMSc (APPLICABLE TO ALL TYPES OF STRUCTURAL CONCRETE)

minimum cover of 3/4 inch is adequate for ratings of 4 hours or less.

beam. For beams in which several bars are used, the cover for corner bars used in the calculation shall be reduced to one-half of the actual value. The cover for an individual bar must be not less than one-half of the value given in Table 721.2.3(3) nor less than 3/4 inch.

MINIMUM COVER FOR PRESTRESSED CONCRETE BEAMS 8 INCHES OR GREATER IN WIDTH

minimum cover of 3/4 inch is adequate for 4-hour ratings or less. MINIMUM COVER FOR PRESTRESSED CONCRETE BEAMS OF ALL WIDTHS

minimum cover of 3/4 inch is adequate for 4-hour ratings or less.

does not exceed three times the average width of the stem.
